proposal.text: Q1: KEEP the 3-minute default. Set at src/hub.ts:65 (`static DEFAULT_NUDGE_MS = Number(process.env.CHATROOM_NUDGE_AFTER_MS ?? 180_000)`), applied per room at hub.ts:94 (legacy fallback src/hub/persistence.ts:77). Where it takes effect: (a) the silence nudge armNudge (hub.ts:1036-1058) is re-armed by every post (hub.ts:985), so a busy nine-seat room rarely trips it, and the same nudge posts at most twice (hub.ts:1054-1056); (b) the openings-reveal deadline: 2 periods at creation (hub.ts:136), 1 period from the first opening (hub.ts:1081), plus one extra period after a warning for seats that never joined (hub.ts:1101-1104); chat does not reset it. Three minutes from the first opening is enough for nine staggered seats to submit, and a late seat can still speak in chat. Shortening it would add noise; lengthening it would hold eight seats for one straggler. Also surfaced to agents at server.ts:325, 442, 464. Q2: only `bench-build-oracle-audit.test.ts` appears more than once in offlineScripts (scripts/offline-runner.mjs:64 and :78). seat-env-regression.ts and claude-lean-flags-regression.ts repeat only outside the array, at :192. Q3: MAX_WAIT_MS = 55_000 at src/server.ts:21, comment "stay under typical MCP client tool timeouts (Codex 60s)". It is enforced at :348 (zod max) and :359 (Math.min). STILL JUSTIFIED: 55s leaves a 5s margin under an external client's 60s default, and wait wakes on events, so the cap costs no latency (DEFAULT_WAIT_MS, :20). The hub's own Codex seats set tool_timeout_sec=120 (src/codex-seat.ts:13), so the comment's justification now applies only to external or unconfigured clients. That is still a valid reason to keep it.

challenge.objection: The claim "so a busy nine-seat room rarely trips it" assumes busy means chatty. In a working session, seats spend minutes in tool calls (builds, tests) without posting, so the whole room can be silent for over 3 minutes while work is progressing. The nudge then says "should propose a conclusion" too early (hub.ts:1048-1050). The doubling cap (hub.ts:1053-1055) limits that noise to two posts, so the verdict can stand. The text should still state this cost, and that one knob drives both the nudge and the reveal deadline, so the nudge can't be lengthened alone.
